## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track D (design rules and UI component setup), wave D1 (c, shell and page components). This is audit backlog UX-16 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: Components only, in /__ui. Later the app shell for every role, and every page title.
Findings and reviewers: F-18, F-22 · reviewers B-07, B-10, B-12, C-08, C-09. Part 1 of 2 of audit backlog UX-16 (part 2 puts them in the shell).
Rationale: Language, My devices and Sign out sit as permanent buttons beside patient search; the rail between 768 and 1279 px is icons with no labels; page titles sit at seven different heights and jump when data loads.
Proposed UX behaviour: AccountMenu: an avatar button that opens a menu with name and role, language, my devices, change facility and, last and separated, sign out; built on the shadcn dropdown menu added through the shadcn CLI; full keyboard support and focus returns to the button on close. NavRailItem: an icon with an 11 px label under it for the 72 px rail; the label is always visible, never a tooltip only. PageHeader gains back and meta slots and one fixed 44 px row: title at 20/28, secondary text (such as the date) after it, actions at the end, with the space for the secondary text reserved while loading so nothing jumps. Tooltip for icon-only buttons: appears on hover and on focus, never the only label for navigation.
Prototype and blueprint reference: docs/product-ux-audit/concepts/medvya-workspace-concept.html, audit note 1; blueprint sections 2, 3 and 7.
Components and tokens affected: New account-menu.tsx, nav-rail-item.tsx, tooltip.tsx, dropdown-menu.tsx (shadcn); page.tsx extended. No new library beyond the shadcn and Radix family already in use.
Front end and back end split: Front end only.
Prerequisites and blocked by: Blocked by the D1a tickets for control defaults and type tokens. File ownership in wave D1c: this ticket owns the four new files and page.tsx.
Clinical sign-off: Not required.
Effort and regression risk: M · Low: nothing uses the new pieces yet; PageHeader keeps its current props.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) Changing AppShell (part 2, wave D2). (2) Renaming navigation items (the names ticket, at a training boundary). (3) An icon-only rail: ruling 8 forbids it as a default.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given the gallery, when the avatar button is focused and Enter is pressed, then the menu opens, arrow keys move through language, my devices, change facility and sign out in that order, Escape closes it and focus returns to the button
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the open menu, when it is read, then sign out is the last item, visually separated, and every item is at least 44 px tall
- [ ] **AC3.** Given NavRailItem at 72 px, when it renders in English and Arabic, then the label is visible text under the icon and is not truncated for the longest translated name
- [ ] **AC4.** Given PageHeader with a title, a date and two actions, when the date arrives after loading, then the title and actions do not move and the row stays 44 px
- [ ] **AC5.** Given an icon button with a Tooltip, when it is focused by keyboard, then the tooltip shows and the button still has an accessible name without it
- [ ] **AC6.** Given the gallery in English and Arabic, when axe runs, then there is no violation

## Test notes

- Vitest: menu order, header slots.
- Playwright on /__ui: keyboard path through the menu; en and ar; axe.

## Notes / open questions

- Regression risk: low.
- Dependency reason for the pull request: shadcn dropdown-menu and tooltip (Radix), same family as the installed dialog and select; no alternative in the library.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
